scope: Cisco IOS XE router and switch automation domain
measurement_rule: Total weight is fixed at 100 points. completed_points may increase only when repository evidence exists and the stated acceptance gate is met. Planning, documentation-only work, synthetic-only evidence, waiting CI, and unsupported feature assumptions do not earn points.

items.title: Cisco governance, vendor isolation, and official-source manifest
evidence: GitHub Actions Governance Gate run 34938186075 PASS
items.next_gate: Keep Cisco IOS XE separate from NX-OS/IOS XR and expand only from approved Cisco sources.

items.title: IOS XE router/switch platform and version admission
items.next_gate: Admission remains documentation-scoped and read-only; unknown platform/version fails closed.

items.title: NETCONF read-only capability and identity discovery
items.next_gate: Parse device NETCONF hello/YANG capabilities and prove read-only identity/version/interface discovery on an identified IOS XE target.

items.title: RESTCONF read-only discovery
items.next_gate: HTTPS RESTCONF read-only discovery with certificate verification, capability binding, secret exclusion, and least privilege.

items.title: Router normalized state
items.next_gate: Normalize interfaces, addressing, routing and relevant router operational state from validated IOS XE models.

items.title: Switch normalized state
items.next_gate: Normalize interfaces, VLAN/trunk and relevant L2 operational state from validated IOS XE models.

items.title: Deterministic Cisco desired-state and renderer catalog
items.next_gate: Feature-by-feature YANG/CLI operations must be authoritative-source bound, dependency aware, version gated, and non-AI-authored.

items.title: Cisco deterministic validation and change approval binding
items.next_gate: Validate exact candidate changeset, bind state/version/knowledge/render hashes, and reject stale approval.

items.title: IOS XE virtual lab acceptance
items.next_gate: Run identified IOS XE virtual target with read/apply/verify/fault evidence without claiming physical hardware.

items.title: Transaction backup, rollback, and recovery
items.next_gate: Prove backup, management survival, induced failure, rollback, restored-state verification, and recovery.

items.title: Physical Cisco read-only acceptance
items.next_gate: Human-attested physical-router/switch read-only evidence; virtual evidence cannot satisfy this gate.

items.title: Production write and handover gate
items.next_gate: Explicit production authorization, exact changeset approval, post-change verification, backups, and handover evidence.
